model_scope: geometric_optics_3d: plane, sphere and sag surfaces (conic, even asphere, cylinder, off-axis sections), reflection, Snell refraction, TIR, ideal thin lens, apertures, grating order directions (vector grating equation)
gaussian_beam: paraxial x/y-independent q-parameter (ABCD, Coddington tilted surfaces at the local principal curvatures), untwisted astigmatism

polarization: Jones calculus with 3D transverse basis transport, Fresnel s/p, stated Faraday rotation; a partially polarized or unpolarized source traced as two mutually incoherent orthogonal Jones components whose Stokes parameters add
birefringence: uniaxial crystals with plane faces (ordinary and extraordinary beams, walk-off of the extraordinary ray, each beam's index along its ray)

second_harmonic_generation: a uniaxial crystal slab with a stated chi(2) coefficient or d tensor, birefringent (type I / II) or quasi-phase matching, angle and temperature tuning; undepleted-pump conversion of a TEM00 Gaussian beam (near field, or Boyd-Kleinman focusing) with walk-off; the harmonic traced as a new spectral line, the fundamental's power reduced by it
interference: analytic two-beam (plane-wave phase, Gaussian envelope) on a plane; no wave propagation
spectrum: discrete mutually incoherent spectral lines; a continuous spectral density traced as midpoint-quadrature lines

scatter: single diffuse surface scatter (Lambertian, cosine-power) traced as incoherent unpolarized rays from the beam's chief-ray hit point; bulk scattering attenuates the beams and is booked, not followed
complex_transmission: thin sample of stated amplitude and phase in an aperture stop; rays take its optical path and phase gradient (geometric), the beam its Gaussian-weighted transmittance
materials: constant / Sellmeier / tabulated index with validity bands; constant and tabulated coatings

sample_emission: fluorescence (absorbed share, quantum yield, emission lines) and spontaneous Stokes Raman scattering (shifts, cross-sections, number density, path length) of a thin sample, derived from the excitation the Project's other sources deliver to it and traced as an incoherent emitter (photon numbers, each photon at its own wavelength)

detection: photodetector photocurrent from the quantum efficiency, white shot / dark / thermal noise in a stated bandwidth and its SNR; square-wave or sinusoidal modulation read by a lock-in (fundamental, RC output filter of 1 to 4 sections)
layout: 2.5D rotated footprints, keepout, beam envelope, plate boundary, moving envelope
control: finite-difference Jacobian, Levenberg-Marquardt, capture scan, deterministic Monte Carlo
